(cha)༄༅/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sgo nas gson gshin gyi sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i cho ga thar pa'i snang 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru badz+ra

tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sgo nas gson gshin gyi sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i cho ga thar pa'i snang 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra ḍā ke bh+yaḥ thabs mkhas thugs rje'i tsha zer gyis// sgrib gnyis mun khang brtol mdzad pa// rdo rje khro bo der btud nas// gzhan phan cho ga'i gsal byed dgod// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i sdig sbyong gis gzhan la phan gdags pa'i rim pa la gnyis/ gson po la bya ba dang*/ gshin po'i don bya ba'o// dang po la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la spros bcas rgyas par byed na mdun du stegs bu'i khar chu gnyis nyer spyod/ slob dpon gyi mdun du nang mchod rdor dril/ zhi ba'i me thab tshad ldan rdza sogs las bcos pa'i dkar po me khrol blugs pa/ bsreg rdzas til nag bcas bsham/ mgyogs khyad spros pa nyer bsdu'i skabs snod me khrol blugs pa dang*/ til nag tsam gyis 'thus/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i thog mar rgyas par kye rdor mdzes rgyan ltar mchod pa byin rlabs/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rdor sems sgom bzlas mthar rang la bstims nas rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal bzung*/ bsgrub bya rnams mdun du 'khod du bcug la bsdu na/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs lta bu'i skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje sems dpa'i skur bsgom/ thab khung*/ oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po/ rgyar khru gang pa/ zabs su khru phyed pa/ kha khyer dang mu ran sor bzhi pa la rdo rje rtse lnga pa zlum pos mtshan pa/ nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la raṃ/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/

de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu bsnol ba mthe'u chung sbrel te sdigs mdzub brkyangs pas 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum pa zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa dang rin po che dang klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs bsnams pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyi ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po bsam/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥbarjod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdabyer med du bstim/ slar yang hūm̐ las 'od 'phros de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lngas oṃ badz+ri bha ba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka sa pa ri bā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yā/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ nang mchod oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis 'bul/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// gang gi thugs rje me phung 'bar ba'i mthus// chags sogs nyes pa'i bud shing kun sreg cing*// bde chen ye shes snang ba rgyas mdzad pa// bcom ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhabs la 'dud// bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/

de nas sdig pa sbyong ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du bsgoms shig khyed rang gi rkang mthil du yam̐ las rlung*/ lte bar gtum mo'i me/ snying gar kam̐ rlung gis me bskyod pas snying ga'i sdig pa'i sa bon kam̐ nag po la tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad bsdus/ sna sgo gnyis nas sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par thon te mdun gyi til la thim/ de bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhal du phul bas rigs drug gi skye gnas kyi bag chags sogs sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad zad par sgoms shig til la sna bug nas rlung 'bud du gzhug de nyid lag pa g.yas pa mtheb srin sbyar bas sngags re re bzhin tshar re thab tu phul la/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmin ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan brgya rtsa brgyad sogs long skabs dang bstun gang 'os 'bul/ thog ma dang tha mar/ bhasmin ku ru zhes pa'i rjes su/ tshe dang ldan pa 'di rnams kyi sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ grib ma'i nyes pa dang*/ nad dang*/ gnod pa dang*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa'i spel tshig kyang sbyar/ gsum pa rjes ni/ grangs rdzogs pa dang gong gsal sngags kyis mchod pa dang bstod pa bya/ tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pas gsol ba gdab/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsams la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces dge ba bsngo/ bsrung bya rnams skad cig gis mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i skur gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis brtan g.yo 'khor 'das thams cad kyi tshe bcud bsdus nas thim pas 'chi med tshe dang ye shes kyi dngos grub thob par gyur/

ces mos la mtshan brgya'i gzungs dang*/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī ban+ti ye swā hā/ ci 'grub brjod/ mthar phyin drug tshigs bcad bkra shis brjod pas grub bo// gal te gson sbyong zhu ba po yul gzhan du gnas pa yin na dmigs rten nṛ yig dang ming byang bris pa'i byang bu 'du bya/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bskyed chog mchod bstod bcas grub pa'i rjes su rten bskyed/ 'gugs gzhug rnams 'og gshin byang gi skabs su 'byung ba ltar kha bsgyur la bya/ sbyong ba gsum po'ang spro na sbyar/ de nas til sbyong dngos la 'jug grangs rdzogs pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhal nas ye shes kyi me lce byung*/ khyed rang gi las dang nyon mongs pas bskyed pa'i rnam smin gyi phung po bag chags dang bcas pa bsregs shing sbyangs/ rang sems rnam par dag pa hrīḥyig dkar po 'od 'bar bar gyur par sgoms shig stong nyid ye shes 'bar ba'i me// tshe ldan sgrib pa'i bud shing dang*// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus pa// ye shes snang bar 'bar gyur cig /ces dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sngags brjod pas thab khung du bsreg rjes mchod bstod phyin gong ltar byas la mthar dbyung ngo*// gson po gam na yod bzhin du byang bu bzhag pa'ang kha gcig gis bshad mod/ de ni ngag rgyun phal pa la gson byang gshin byang zer ba las 'khrul pa ste gson po'i sdig sbyong yin pas gson sbyong gdags su rung zhing*/ gson po la byang bu dgos pa gang nas kyang ma bshad cing*/ khyad par gnas spor lam bstan sogs ni gtan nas mi 'brel ba'i rang bzo kho nar zad la/ 'di ltar sdig sbyong tsam byed pa ni rgyud nyid kyi dgongs pa dang*/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas snying po rgyan du ltung ba sbyong ba'i sgo nyer lnga'i nang tshan du man ngag gis gsal bar dbye bar mdzad pa ltar brgyud pa khungs btsun rnams kyi phyag bzhes su yongs grags 'byung ba ltar bkod pa'o// gnyis pa gshin po'i byang bu bya ba ni/

rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud man ngag rnams su gsal bar gsungs pa med kyang*/ sbyong rgyud las/ gshin po'i ro'am rus pa'am skra sen sogs la'ang cho ga bya bar gsungs pa'i rigs pas gson po'i sdig sbyong la kha spos te bya bar 'dod na/ dmigs rten ro sogs yod na des 'thus la med na byang bu spyi ltar dang*/ mdun du stegs bur phyi mchod/ rgyas spros byed na gtor 'bul yang bsham/ me thab dang*/ til/ zhi drag gi sbyong chas rnams bshams la/ sngon 'gro mchod pa byin rlabs/ skyabs sems/ rdor sems sgom bzlas rnams btang la rang rdo rje sems dpa' 'am yi dam gang yin gyi nga rgyal la gnas pas/ me thab dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro bskyed nas mchod bstod bar sngar smos pa ltar btang*/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi ge lnga dang bcas pa 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥphyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro bas/ i daṃ ba liṃ bhu ñja kha kha khā hi khā hi lan gsum mam lngas phul/ mthar phyi nang gi mchod pa dang bstod pas bstod/ tshe las 'das pa'i tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces gsol ba gdab/ de nas byang bu la chab bran bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las byang stegs pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nṛ las tshe las 'das pa phung khams skye mched thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gson po'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi rgya bcas/ na mo/

sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo nams kyi= bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs pa la brten nas/ tshe las 'das pa'i rnam par shes pa khams gsum skye gnas bzhi rigs drug gang na gnas kyang skad cig gis 'dir mchis par gyur cig nṛ ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ lan gsum gyis dgug sbyong gtor 'bru gsum gyis byin brlab/ zhi sbyong ni gtor ma g.yas su bskor cing*/ sarba bigh+nān na ma sarba sogs/ gsum/ zhi drag phye ma ni ting lo changs bu g.yon du bskor la/ sum+bha sogs lan gsum/ drag pos sbyong ba ni/ spro na khro bo spyan 'dren sogs bya/ bsdu na gong gi bden brjod tsam gyi mjug tu/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs la brten nas tshe las 'das pa'i lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma lam brngan/ changs bu lam brgyags/ ting lo lam sgron gyi tshul du khyer la phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig gal te 'gro bar mi byed na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar bas bgegs rnams brlag par 'gyur ba gdon mi za'o// zhes dang sum+bha'i drag sngags yungs thun gu gul dud pas bskrad do// tshe las 'das pa'i rkang mthil du yam̐ las rlung*/ lte bar ram̐ las me/ snying gar kam̐ yig nag po las tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad bsdus/ yaṃ las rlung gis bskyod pas lte ba'i me 'bar bas kaṃ sna sgo nas ded/ sha za'i gzugs su gyur pa mdun gyi til la thim/ de nyid bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhal du phul bas sdig sgrib thams cad lhag med du sbyangs par mos shig g.yas kyi mtheb srin gyis til me thab tu phul la/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi/

sarba pā paṃ da ha na shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ spro na thog mtha' rnams su spel tshig kyang sbyar la grangs ji tsam nus pa phul ba'i mthar/ tshe las 'das pa'i rigs drug gi skye gnas ma lus pa byang zhing dag nas rnam shes a dkar po dri ma med pa zhig tu gyur/ de nas dmigs pa 'di ltar sgoms shig mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mkha' 'gro la bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bskor ba sprin phung ltar bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar khyed rang rnams kyis gtso byas pa'i rigs drug gi sems can thams cad lus zhing rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa sprul nas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas tshul bzhin du bshags par bgyi'o snyam pas phyag 'tshal ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas thams cad sogs/ gtso bo rgyal ba sogs brjod la byang phyag 'tshal du gzhug de nas byang bu slob dpon gyis thogs la/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes pa khyod sems ma yengs par nyon cig 'di ltar gzugs la sogs par snang ba'i chos bdag gzhan gyi tshor ba bde sdug 'du shes la sogs pa thams cad kyi med pa la yod par bzung ste/ don la med bzhin du 'khrul snang gis bsdus pa'i sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong dgos pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje dung pa zhig bsgoms pas/ stong nyid snying rje zung du 'brel ba'i sgo nas/ khyod rang gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa srid pa bar do'i 'khrul snang*/ phyi ma ngan song gsum du skye 'gyur gyi las ngan ji snyed yod pa thams cad bsreg bya bud shing gi rnam par gyur/ skyabs slu ba med pa dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs/ cho ga rnam par dag pa'i nus mthu/

nye du 'brel pa shul na mchis pa rnams kyis dge rtsa bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid bzhin pa dang*/ khyod rang rnams kyi shes rgyud kyi steng na dge ba'i rtsa ba ci yod pa thams cad blos phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas ye shes me'i rnam par gyur/ me de nyid kyis bsreg bya bud shing 'bras bu sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa bsreg bya sreg byed dang bral ba'i tshul gyis bsregs pas/ khyed rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba de nyid skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing du rgyal ba 'od dpag med pa'i zhabs drung du 'khod de/ de'ang gsal stong 'dzin pa ma mchis pa'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ zhes brjod la/ stong nyid ye shes 'bar ba'i me// tshe 'das sgrib pa'i bud shing dang*// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus pa// ye shes snang bar 'bar gyur cig /ces dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sngags mang du brjod la bsreg 'khor gsum spros bral gyis lta bas rgyas btab la mnyam par bzhag lam sbyong bstan ni/ dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing du/ dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba// dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyis// rin chen phreng ba rnam dag pa// tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam// mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam// bla na med pa'i khyad par lam// byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam// rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la// brten nas sdig pa kun sbyangs te// 'phags pa'i lam der 'gro bar shog /oṃ rat+ne rat+ne ma hā rat+ne/ rat+na saṃ bha be/ rat+na ki ra ṇe/ rat+na ma la bi shud+dhe sho dha ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pad+ma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar// srid gsum dri mas ma gos shing*// srid pa'i pad+ma las byung ba// bde ba can du skye bar shog /oṃ pad+me pad+me pad+ma saṃ bha we mahā su kha ba te gats+tshan+tu swā hā/ rjes mchod pa kha gsos la sngags kyis mchod cing bstod/ 'dod don gsol/

yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs dang*/ badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bstim/ rang rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis bsrung*/ bsngo ba dang smon lam rgyas par bya zhing shis pa brjod pas mtha' brten no// gshin byang bshad khungs sbyong rgyud yin mod kyang*// bod 'dir rang bzo'i spros pa la dgyes pas// 'dir yang gson sdig sbyong bas rigs 'gres te// phyag len dar bas zhar 'phros tshul du bkod// dmigs bsal bkag pa med cing sdig sbyong sgor// grags pa lag tu blangs pas 'brel thogs kyi// 'gro ba'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung rtsad nas bcom// bde chen rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sar 'god shog /ces pa'ang rje btsun bla ma thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i bzhed pa'i lhag ma bskang ba'i slad du rje nyid kyi dgongs bzhed dang mthun par 'du gsum rnal 'byor spyod pa blo gros mtha' yas kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
